ink-carbon.$description: Ink Carbon — Primary text, logo mark, dark surface inversions, footer text on cream — a near-black with a barely-warm undertone that keeps the page from feeling clinical

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas and nav surface — the warm-white background that everything floats on

whisper-taupe.$description: Whisper Taupe — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels.

bone-cream.$description: Bone Cream — Alternate panel background and footer band — a warm cream that signals a quieter section without leaving the monochrome family

lampblack.$description: Lampblack — Deep surface for inversions and image overlays — slightly cooler than Ink Carbon, used where absolute darkness is needed without color cast

signal-orange.$description: Signal Orange — Decorative illustration accent — appears inside graphic bands and artwork, never as a UI control fill

amber-pulse.$description: Amber Pulse — Decorative illustration accent — companion to Signal Orange inside warm gradient bands and visual punctuation

good-sans.$description: Single voice across the entire interface — body, nav, buttons, headings, and display all share weight 400. The absence of bold is the signature: hierarchy comes from size and color, not weight.
